sources.entry: Atsumeru - Manga/comic/light novel media server with clients for Windows, Linux, macOS and Android. (Source Code, Clients) MIT Java/Docker

summary.one_liner: Atsumeru is a free, self-hosted media server for manga, comics and light novels, with native clients for Windows, Linux, macOS and Android.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a self-hosted server for importing and reading manga, comics and light novels through native clients on Windows, Linux, Mac and Android. Library organization uses Autocategories, Custom categories and Metacategories. Metadata can be edited and parsed from supported catalogs, and it is auto-imported from ComicInfo.xml and book_info.json files. It supports multiple users with separate history and access controls, lets supported apps download whole series, and exposes a REST API with Swagger-UI documentation. The README says it is distributed as a .jar file and as a Docker image.
use_cases: serve light novels to family members
download whole comic series to phone
how_to_run: Download the actual .jar file from the Releases section
Set it up by following the official setup guide
Alternatively, run the server using the Docker image (see Docker setup in the README)
notable: Native clients for Windows, Linux, Mac and Android
Autocategories, custom categories and metacategories for library organization
Multi-user support with separate history and access controls
caveats: Setup details are delegated to an external official guide and the Atsumeru website wiki, not included in the README
The README does not describe iOS or web-browser clients
